text:
The plate is about 26 cm across in the image, which is roughly 470 px, so 1 cm is about 18 px.

The food is roasted sweet potato cubes, about 9 pieces. Each piece is roughly 3 cm across and 1.5–2 cm thick, so about 15 g each. That gives about 135 g in total, or perhaps 120 g.

I count a few small white bits as garlic or salt crumbs, which are negligible. A little white piece sits near the right edge, probably onion or a bit of cheese, and it is too small to matter.

Roasted sweet potato is about 120–140 kcal per 100 g, and it looks slightly glossy, so I'll use 135.
